summary: This study looks at how specific genes affect the body's response to food and a diabetes drug called metformin. Researchers want to see if these responses differ between people who carry certain genes linked to type 2 diabetes and those who do not. Participants take part in a mixed meal tolerance test, which is a test using a specially prepared meal containing protein, carbohydrate, and fat. Massachusetts General Hospital is sponsoring this clinical trial, which has an enrollment of 1017 participants.
